cause: addCallJavaActionAction (mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go) gave only entity-type and Microflow parameters their own value; a text-template parameter (CodeActions$StringTemplateParameterType) and a custom-document parameter (CodeActions$CustomBlobDocumentParameterType) fell to the default Microflows$BasicCodeActionParameterValue with the argument's source text. insight: **No Studio Pro reference exists here** (searched every .mpr/.mxunit/.mpk on the machine: 0 StringTemplateParameterValue, 0 CustomBlobDocumentParameterType outside module definitions; the Studio Pro MCP tunnel was down), so the shapes come from generated/metamodel and were *measured* against mxbuild 11.13 by hand-patching the unit (a throwaway Go probe over the v1 Unit table). What the probes settled, none of it guessable: a TypedTemplate argument is Microflows$PrimitiveTypedTemplateArgument{Expression, Type}; **Type is checked against the expression** (CE0117 for String-typed Integer, Integer-typed String, and for any Type on an enumeration expression — an enum is not one of the five); an absent Type reads as String; {1} with no argument is CE0720; Long attributes take Integer; `[%CurrentDateTime%]` takes DateTime — and exprcheck's inferKind calls every token a String, so use its argKind (now InferArgumentKind), which the built-in-function check already special-cased. The runtime hands Type to Java (ITemplateParameter.getParameterType), so the type is semantics, not decoration. For the document value mxbuild reports a wrong-type document as CE0115 and a missing one as CE1613 — check --references resolves agent-editor documents for that reason. The REST-body rule (#1444) carries over: a non-literal is '{1}' with the expression; but **describe must print `$X`, not `'{1}' with ({1} = $X)`**, because the declared-match pass (flow_declared_match) cannot know which CallArgument is a template, so only the short form re-execs as 'Unchanged' — except when the one argument is itself a string literal, which would read back as the text. A pre-fix build is no control for a script-created action: `create java action … StringTemplate(Text)` wrote a String parameter (separate fix), so the control is fixed-build action + pre-fix microflow (CE0115 x2), and the BusinessEvents module (CE0115 per call -> 0 errors)
